title: Field Papers: Private Instructions
text:
PRIVATE

You already hold my commission. Conduct yourself as a civilian. These papers confer no public rank. Do not claim Embassy protection to settle a private quarrel.

Read these papers and file an acknowledgment with your orders. Reports travel with the next dispatch; replies require a full day.

Ordinary observation is permitted. Disclosure, political commitments, and the removal of persons are separate decisions. Permission concerning one case says nothing about another.

Your work precedes any distinction Skyrim may later confer upon you. Remember that.

Elenwen

title: Confidential Commission
text:
For the bearer alone

Your existing appointment as a confidential field officer remains in force. Maintain your civilian identity and report by the agreed channel. The enclosed one hundred septims are an initial allowance, not an advance against a claim.

Do not present yourself as a uniformed member of my delegation, promise favors in my name, or treat personal acquaintance as operational authority. Further instructions await at the secure box. Audiences are by summons.

Elenwen
First Emissary

title: Instruction 1001: Field Protocol
text:
Read your private field papers and file the acknowledgment. Ten days are allowed from collection.

This instruction confirms receipt of procedure. It does not certify lodging, a cover identity, or a completed investigation.

Elenwen

title: Instruction 1002: Wine Procurement
text:
Obtain three bottles of ordinary Alto wine. Deliver them through the secure box within ten days of collecting this instruction. Substitute vintages are not required.

Thirty septims is the normal expense ceiling. If an advance is needed, request supply authority before collecting eighty septims from Accounts. Return unused money within fourteen days of receiving it.

A gift or dinner is not automatically a service expense. No fee is offered for this duty.

Elenwen

title: Instruction 1003: Materials for the Stillroom
text:
Supply six blue mountain flowers for the stillroom. Gather them or obtain them lawfully. Deliver them through dispatch within ten days of collection.

Do not submit an inflated account for an afternoon's gathering. There is no separate reward for this duty.

By instruction of the First Emissary

title: Filed Acknowledgment: Field Protocol
text:
Instruction 1001

The private field papers have been read. The bearer acknowledges the limits on disclosure, expenditure, and public representation.

Filed through the secure dispatch channel.

title: Filed Delivery: Alto Wine
text:
Instruction 1002

Three bottles of Alto wine were deposited with this report. Receipt of the physical consignment is recorded by dispatch.

Any declared expense is subject to a separate Accounts decision.

title: Filed Delivery: Blue Mountain Flowers
text:
Instruction 1003

Six blue mountain flowers were deposited with this report. Receipt of the physical consignment is recorded by dispatch.

No reimbursement is requested.

title: Response 1001: Acknowledgment Accepted
text:
Your acknowledgment has been received and filed. The instruction is complete.

Understanding a procedure is useful only if you observe it when it becomes inconvenient.

Elenwen

title: Response 1002: Delivery Accepted
text:
Instruction 1002 is complete. The wine consignment was filed within the time allowed.

A purchase does not require ceremony. It requires the right goods, delivered when requested. Any outstanding advance remains accountable until settled or returned.

Elenwen

title: Response 1003: Delivery Accepted
text:
Instruction 1003 is complete. The stillroom has accepted the six flowers, filed within the time allowed.

Small provisions keep larger work moving. Do not mistake their simplicity for permission to disregard them.

Elenwen

title: Filed Extension Request: Instruction 1001
text:
Instruction 1001: Field Protocol

The bearer requests an additional five days on the instruction identified in the dispatch register. The existing due date remains in effect until a response is collected.

A completed instruction cannot be reopened by this application.

title: Extension Approved: Instruction 1001
text:
Instruction 1001: Field Protocol

An additional five days is allowed on the instruction recorded with this response. If overdue, the five days run from collection of this letter.

This concession will not be repeated. If the work has already been filed, no further action is required.

title: Further Extension Refused: Instruction 1001
text:
Instruction 1001: Field Protocol

The instruction has already received an extension. No further time is allowed. File the work or account for the delay.

An overdue instruction remains your responsibility.

title: Filed Request: Supply Advance
text:
Instruction 1002

The bearer requests authority to draw an eighty-septim procurement advance. The normal allowable expense remains thirty septims. Unused funds will be returned within fourteen days of collection.

title: Authorization 1002: Supply Advance
text:
Instruction 1002 only

Authority is granted to draw eighty septims while procurement remains open. This is an advance, not an increase in the thirty-septim expense allowance.

No authority is granted to disclose protected information, make political commitments, or remove any person.

Elenwen

title: Accounts: Advance Receipt
text:
Instruction 1002

Eighty septims issued as an operational advance. Approved costs settle this sum before any cash reimbursement. Return the unused balance within fourteen days.

Personal spending from the advance remains payable by the bearer.

title: Accounts: Funds Returned
text:
Funds were received against the bearer's outstanding advance and operational liability. The current balance is available at the dispatch box.

This acknowledgment does not authorize another advance.

title: Accounts: Overdue Advance
text:
Instruction 1002

The fourteen-day accounting period has expired. Unreturned funds have become the bearer's liability. Further advances are suspended while money remains due.

Return the funds through dispatch. A valid later claim may discharge recognized costs against this balance.

title: Claim 1002: Supplies, Thirty Septims
text:
Declared cost: thirty septims. Purpose: procurement of the delivered Alto wine. Payee: supplier declared by the bearer.

This declaration is submitted for Accounts review; it is not independent proof of a shop transaction.

title: Claim 1002: Supplies, Eighty Septims
text:
Declared cost: eighty septims. Purpose: procurement of the delivered Alto wine. Payee: supplier declared by the bearer.

This exceeds the written thirty-septim allowance and requires review.

title: Claim 1002: Personal Gift
text:
Declared cost: thirty septims. Purpose: a personal gift associated by the bearer with the procurement errand.

No instruction required this gift. Its inclusion is expressly disclosed.

title: Claim 1002: Meal
text:
Declared cost: thirty septims. Purpose: a meal during the procurement errand.

The connection to the instruction has not been explained. No reimbursement is presumed.

title: Accounts Decision: Approved
text:
The declared thirty-septim supply expense is allowed.

Recognized costs first settle an advance or audited liability. Any balance due to the bearer is paid on collection. This decision may be used once only.

The declared cost stays within my instruction. That is the standard I expect.

Elenwen

title: Accounts Decision: Partially Approved
text:
Instruction 1002

Of the eighty septims declared for wine procurement, thirty are allowed. The fifty-septim excess remains personal expenditure. Any portion paid from the advance remains payable to Accounts.

Consult the statement for the settlement.

An eighty-septim advance was permission to draw funds, not to ignore a thirty-septim ceiling. The distinction should have been clear.

Elenwen

title: Accounts Decision: Denied
text:
Personal expenditure is not chargeable to the Embassy. Any portion drawn from the advance is due from the bearer.

Your availability to an acquaintance is not evidence of an operational requirement.

By instruction of the First Emissary

You were sent to procure supplies. Your personal generosity remains your own responsibility.

Elenwen

title: Accounts Decision: Explanation Required
text:
The meal claim is returned without settlement. Explain whether it was a necessary supplier meeting or personal entertainment.

Submit the explanation at the dispatch box. No money is paid by this letter.

This request does not suspend the fourteen-day obligation to account for the advance. A later accepted explanation may discharge recognized costs against any audited liability.

Explain the purpose plainly. A meal does not become Embassy business merely because it occurred during an errand.

Elenwen

title: Filed Explanation: Supplier Meeting
text:
Instruction 1002

The bearer declares that the meal was a necessary meeting with the wine supplier, rather than personal entertainment. Thirty septims are claimed; no more than fifteen are allowable.

The declaration is submitted for Accounts review. A decision follows by return dispatch.

title: Filed Extension Request: Instruction 1002
text:

The bearer requests an additional five days on the instruction identified in the dispatch register. The existing due date remains in effect until a response is collected.

title: Further Extension Refused: Instruction 1003

Instruction 1003: Stillroom Materials

The instruction has already received an extension. No further time is allowed. File the work or account for the delay.

An overdue instruction remains your responsibility.

title: Filed Explanation: Personal Entertainment
text:
Instruction 1002

The bearer declares that the thirty-septim meal was personal entertainment. No operational order required it.

This explanation is submitted to Accounts. The decision follows by return dispatch.

title: Accounts Decision: Meal Allowance
text:
Instruction 1002

Fifteen septims of the thirty-septim supplier-meeting meal are allowed. The remaining fifteen are personal expenditure.

Recognized costs first settle outstanding advances or audited liability; any remaining amount is reimbursed on collection.

A necessary meeting may justify a modest expense. It does not justify the entire bill you have submitted.

Elenwen

title: Instruction 1004: Fuel for the Dispatch Room
text:
The dispatch room must remain usable through cold evenings. Supply six pieces of firewood through the secure box. Ordinary split wood will suffice; no special timber is wanted.

Ten days are allowed from collection. Use your initial allowance where necessary. No separate advance, expense claim, or completion fee is authorized for this duty.

Elenwen

title: Filed Delivery 1004: Fuel for the Dispatch Room
text:
Instruction 1004

The bearer consigned six pieces of firewood through the secure dispatch channel. The physical delivery is recorded with this report. No reimbursement is requested.

title: Response 1004: Delivery Accepted
text:
Instruction 1004 is complete.

The wood has reached the dispatch room. A clerk with warm hands is less likely to spoil a cipher. Attend to small requirements before they become large inconveniences.

Elenwen

title: Filed Extension Request: Instruction 1004
text:
Instruction 1004: Fuel for the Dispatch Room

The bearer requests an additional five days. The current deadline remains in force until the response is collected. Filing the work before that response closes the instruction without reopening it.

title: Extension Approved: Instruction 1004
text:
Instruction 1004: Fuel for the Dispatch Room

Five additional days are allowed. If the instruction is overdue, the five days run from collection of this letter. Work already filed requires no further action.

This concession will not be repeated.

Elenwen

title: Further Extension Refused: Instruction 1004
text:
Instruction 1004: Fuel for the Dispatch Room

You have already received an extension. No further time is allowed. An overdue duty remains your responsibility; complete it and file your report.

Elenwen

title: Instruction 1005: Bindings for Confidential Papers
text:
The document cases require fresh bindings. Supply four leather strips through dispatch. Do not send complete hides or finished armor. Obtain the material lawfully; this instruction gives no claim on a craftsman's stock.

Ten days are allowed from collection. Use your initial allowance where necessary. No separate advance, expense claim, or completion fee is authorized for this duty.

Elenwen

title: Filed Delivery 1005: Bindings for Confidential Papers
text:
Instruction 1005

The bearer consigned four leather strips through the secure dispatch channel. The physical delivery is recorded with this report. No reimbursement is requested.

title: Response 1005: Delivery Accepted
text:
Instruction 1005 is complete.

The bindings have been replaced. A sealed case is a modest thing on which a great deal may depend. I expect you to remember that when handling the papers inside it.

Elenwen

title: Instruction 1006: Stillroom Reserve
text:
Supply six measures of wheat for the stillroom reserve. Deliver the raw ingredient through dispatch, rather than bread or flour. This is a small replenishment, not authority to requisition a farm's harvest.

Ten days are allowed from collection. Use your initial allowance where necessary. No separate advance, expense claim, or completion fee is authorized for this duty.

Elenwen

title: Filed Delivery 1006: Stillroom Reserve
text:
Instruction 1006

The bearer consigned six measures of wheat through the secure dispatch channel. The physical delivery is recorded with this report. No reimbursement is requested.

title: Response 1006: Delivery Accepted
text:
Instruction 1006 is complete.

The stillroom reserve has been replenished. Your instructions did not require an expedition or a public display of importance. Quiet completion is entirely sufficient.

Elenwen

title: Filed Extension Request: Instruction 1006
text:
Instruction 1006: Stillroom Reserve

The bearer requests an additional five days. The current deadline remains in force until the response is collected. Filing the work before that response closes the instruction without reopening it.

text:

You have already received an extension. No further time is allowed. An overdue duty remains your responsibility; complete it and file your report.

Elenwen

title: Response 1001: Prompt Service
text:
Instruction 1001 is complete.

You have acknowledged the field procedure promptly. Good. A rule read before it is needed has some chance of being observed when it matters.

Elenwen

title: Response 1001: Delay Noted
text:
Instruction 1001 is complete.

Your acknowledgment is accepted, but the file records a missed deadline. Procedure is the foundation of this appointment. Treat reading it as work in its own right.

Elenwen

title: Response 1002: Prompt Service
text:
Instruction 1002 is complete.

The wine arrived with ample time to spare. I prefer a modest request completed promptly to an elaborate account of why it proved difficult. Any procurement claim remains a separate matter for Accounts.

Elenwen

title: Response 1002: Delay Noted
text:
Instruction 1002 is complete.

The wine has been received. The missed deadline is also recorded. An ordinary procurement duty should not require this much patience. Any account remains subject to its written allowance.

Elenwen

title: Response 1003: Prompt Service
text:
Instruction 1003 is complete.

The flowers reached the stillroom promptly. Its work need not pause while a field officer decides whether a small errand is beneath their attention.

Elenwen

title: Response 1003: Delay Noted
text:
Instruction 1003 is complete.

The flowers have been received. The file records that this duty missed a deadline. The stillroom cannot plan its work around an officer's changing priorities.

Elenwen

title: Response 1004: Prompt Service
text:
Instruction 1004 is complete.

The fuel arrived before the dispatch room needed it. Anticipating a small inconvenience is part of competent service.

Elenwen

title: Response 1004: Delay Noted
text:
Instruction 1004 is complete.

The wood is accepted. Its arrival does not erase the missed deadline recorded against this instruction. Small provisions cease to be small matters when others must wait for them.

Elenwen

title: Response 1005: Prompt Service
text:
Instruction 1005 is complete.

The leather bindings arrived promptly. The clerks can now finish their work without borrowing time from mine.

Elenwen

title: Response 1005: Delay Noted
text:
Instruction 1005 is complete.

The bindings are accepted. The record of delay remains. Confidential papers should not sit unsecured while a simple supply duty awaits attention.

Elenwen

title: Response 1006: Prompt Service
text:
Instruction 1006 is complete.

The wheat reached the stillroom with time to spare. Reliable replenishment attracts little notice. You should regard that as a useful quality.

Elenwen

title: Response 1006: Delay Noted
text:
Instruction 1006 is complete.

The wheat is accepted. A missed deadline is recorded against the instruction. Replenishment should follow the needs of the stillroom, not the convenience of your itinerary.

Elenwen

title: Filed Docket: Closing Review
text:
Instructions 1001-1006

Both packets have been completed and their responses collected. The filing dates and available Accounts record are submitted for the First Emissary's closing review. Her response will follow by the next dispatch.

This docket requests no payment or change in public standing.

title: Private Assessment: Dependable Service
text:
Instructions 1001-1006

The two packets are closed. At the time of review, the record contains no missed deadlines or adverse Accounts finding, and no advance remains outstanding.

You have attended to unremarkable work without making it troublesome. That is a useful beginning. Dependability is established in these details long before it is tested in an important matter.

Your commission continues on its existing terms. This letter confers no public rank or additional authority.

Elenwen

title: Private Assessment: Further Care Required
text:
Instructions 1001-1006

The two packets are closed and the work has been accepted. The filing dates and Accounts record have also been reviewed. There is room for greater care in your handling of these duties.

Completion is necessary. Judgement about time and expenditure is part of the same responsibility. Carry that lesson into your next instructions.

Your existing commission remains in force. No additional authority or payment is conferred by this assessment.

Elenwen

title: Private Assessment: Formal Reprimand
text:
Instructions 1001-1006

The two packets are closed. I have accepted the completed work, but the record warrants a reprimand. The deficiencies in timeliness or the handling of expenses are material to my assessment of your service.

Consult the filed decisions. Any money still shown as outstanding must be returned through Accounts. Accepting your reports does not cancel that obligation.

Your commission continues. I expect closer attention to the terms of future instructions; this letter enlarges none of your authority.

Elenwen
